preconditions.description: The number of brains in the final nervous system is between 2 and 200000, inclusive.
The list p contains n - 1 numbers, representing the parent-brains for each new brain added.

postconditions.description: The output contains n - 1 numbers, representing the brain latency after each brain is added.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == latency_after_adding_brain(i + 2) for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each output number is the latency of the brain after it is added to the system.
